recommendations.name: Dash0 AutoMerge
recommendations.description: An observability platform whose generally available approval agent scores each GitHub or GitLab pull request against weighted criteria and protected paths, then auto-approves or auto-merges the low-risk ones, with a dry-run mode to try it first.

recommendations.name: Cursor PR Routing & Approval
recommendations.description: Not an observability tool, but its approval agent can automatically approve low-risk PRs using a risk score, APPROVAL_POLICY.md files and Bugbot findings, and it won't approve above your threshold.

recommendations.name: Ona auto-approval pattern
recommendations.description: Not an observability tool or a built-in feature, but a documented way to build auto-approval of low-risk PRs on Ona's code review automation using objective criteria, with a human still clicking merge.
